description: Sends an email immediately from the Naver Mail account (SMTP) and saves a copy in Sent. To send an existing draft, give draftId. To thread under an existing conversation give replyThreadId or replyToMessageId. Confirm recipients and content with the user before sending.

attachments.description: Attachments. Combined size must not exceed 25MB.

filename.description: File name shown to recipients, e.g. "invoice.pdf".

inline.description: If true, an inline image referenced from htmlBody as where N is its zero-based index in attachments.

mimeType.description: IANA MIME type. Defaults to application/octet-stream.

bcc.description: Bcc recipients. Plain email addresses (e.g. "user@example.com"); "Name <user@example.com>" also works.

body.description: Plain text body. Do NOT format with Markdown; use htmlBody for rich text. If htmlBody is also given, this is the plain-text alternative.

cc.description: Cc recipients. Plain email addresses (e.g. "user@example.com"); "Name <user@example.com>" also works.

draftId.description: Send this draft as is; other fields are ignored. The draft is removed after sending.

replyThreadId.description: Thread the message under this thread (replies to its latest message).

replyToMessageId.description: Thread the message as a reply to this message.

to.description: Primary recipients. Required unless draftId is given. Plain email addresses (e.g. "user@example.com"); "Name <user@example.com>" also works.

name: send_message
